title: Geometry Dash Evidence Provenance Schema
description: Canonical immutable provenance schema for all artifacts in the Geometry Dash security system. Frozen at startup, non-negotiable. All 12 fields are mandatory.

artifact_id.description: Unique artifact identifier (UUID v4 or SHA256 hash)

produced_time_ns.description: Nanosecond timestamp when artifact was produced (Unix epoch). Must be monotonically increasing.

produced_by_principal.description: Principal process that produced this artifact

data_class.description: Data classification of this artifact (per P1.1 §3)

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of artifact file contents (hex-encoded)

artifact_hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used for artifact_hash (must always be SHA-256, per REQ-CRYPTO-008)

source_evidence_id.description: If this artifact was derived from another, the source artifact's ID. Null if original.

transform_rule.description: If derived, which transformation rule applied (e.g., 'collision_detected_to_sparse_reward'). Null if original.

classification_changed.description: True if this artifact resulted in a classification change (e.g., PRIVILEGED → DECLASSIFIED)

declassifier_principal.description: If data was declassified, which principal performed the declassification (should be PRN-DECLASSIFIER). Null if never declassified.

declassified_time_ns.description: Nanosecond timestamp of declassification (if classification_changed=true). Null otherwise.

witness_principal.description: Principal that witnessed/signed this artifact (for classification changes and sensitive operations, per P1.3 §4)

witness_signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature by witness_principal over (artifact_id || produced_time_ns || data_class || artifact_hash)

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run/session (UUID v4)

boot_id.description: Unique identifier for this boot (from kernel /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id or UUID)

epoch_id.description: Epoch identifier for this run (used for key rotation tracking)

description_extended: IMMUTABLE SCHEMA (frozen at startup). Per REQ-EVIDENCE-001 and P1.3 §2.1. All fields are mandatory. No runtime modifications permitted. Gate I audit (REQ-GATE-004) verifies all artifacts against this schema.
